verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents card tables suited to work 'with distinct stages' and reusable templates that keep the 'same structure, workflows, and setup' across projects. This loosely implies configurable workflow stages, but the evidence never explicitly says statuses or columns can be customized, and says nothing about custom fields. missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable workflow statuses/columns, any custom-fields capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can customize fields and workflow statuses to match my team's process

citations.quote: Perfect for bug and issue tracking, software development, production work, or anything with distinct stages.
Create reusable project and to-do list templates with the same structure, workflows, and setup across projects.
Add the tools you need (to-dos, message boards, chat, a calendar, card tables)
